statement:
∀ (p j k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k →
  ∀ (h : p^j ∣ p^k) (N : ZMod (p^k)) (f : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ),
    let π := ZMod.castHom h (ZMod (p^j))
    let P := fun (g : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p^k)) =>
      (∑ y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p^k))).filter (fun y => IsUnit y ∧ π y = π x), g y) /
        ((p : ℂ)^(k-j))
    let K := fun (g : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p^k)) =>
      if IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit (N-x) then g (N-x) else 0
    P (K f) = K (P f)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0007 · 证明素幂纤维平均与单位反射交换
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0007 · Commute averaging over prime-power fibers with unit reflection

brief.zh: 固定 1≤j≤k。模 p^j 的约化保留单位条件，并把反射后的纤维送到反射类，纤维大小是 p^(k−j)。最低模 p 留在分解内。
brief.en: Fix 1≤j≤k. Reduction to p^j preserves the unit mask and reflection sends each fiber to the reflected class. The fiber size is p^(k−j). Keep the level modulo p as the bottom block.
